description: Registration data for one domain, read from the registry's own RDAP service through the IANA bootstrap — not scraped from port-43 whois text. Returns creation, expiry and last-change dates, age and days to expiry, registrar, EPP status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC and the abuse contact. TLDs with no RDAP server say so instead of reporting the domain as unregistered. No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

domain.description: The domain to look up. A full URL or an email address is accepted and reduced to its host.

name: red_whois
title: Domain registration lookup (RDAP)
